evidence: The 0ff6d78 diff of quickstart-work.md adds the sentence "six hours of lane-wide silence lapses it". guidance_note: When adding user-facing prose that restates a mechanism (whose clock lapses a claim), copy the qualifier from the canonical definition (holder's own LastActivity). Don't paraphrase it more loosely.

narrative: Most findings are documentation drift from the original PR's behavior change: the own-lapsed lane flipped from laneOurs to laneLapsed, and the docs and tables describing the old reading were not swept (F4, F5, F6). The round-0 summary already named the stale takeover-table row as an out-of-diff finding, and the agent addressed only the inline citation (F1). Commit 0ff6d78 also added unrelated new prose and logic; its loose "lane-wide silence" wording drew F3. The agent then pushed the F5 fix alone (5c1c506), so round 2 re-raised the still-pending F6 as F7 and produced a false-premise citation finding (F8).
guidance_observations: Round-0 summary findings listed as 'outside the reviewed diff' were not acted on in the first fix push, which deferred F5 by a full round.
The agent pushed round-1 fixes in two commits with a review between them; round 2 reviewed a partial fix set and re-raised an open thread.
The commit named as F1's fix also carried new behavior (lapsed lane as an abandonment proof) and new quickstart prose, which widened what round 1 had to review.
